profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: We're a company of pioneers. It's our job to make bold bets, and we get our energy from inventing on behalf of customers. Success is measured against the possible, not the probable. For today’s pioneers, that’s exactly why there’s no place on Earth they’d rather build than Amazon.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Working to bring creator content to Amazon and transform the shopping experience. Our team provides tools and systems for ingesting this content at scale and making it available to teams across Amazon to create new experiences for our customers.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Lead the launch and expansion of the Amazon Follow program, connecting customers with the authors, brands, and interests they are most interested in.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintaining existing applications and developing new features and tools to support the business
* Development in C# and VB (.NET 1.0 and up)
* Developed responsive internal and external websites with ASP.NET and jQuery
* Developed SQL Scripts and Stored Procedures
* Configuring web site settings in IIS
* Managing SVN branches for our various projects
* Part of On-Call rotation to handle support issues that arise
* Documentation of new projects and current processes
* Scrum Master for software iterations with off shore team

positions.title: Student Assistant II
positions.description:
Rollout and Preparing 100+ computers
Building and maintaining multiple servers
Developing scripts to simplify administrator tasks
Developed a comprehensive student administration application to interface with Active Directory
Developed a touch screen application for student processing and information

positions.title: Undergrad Assistant
positions.description:
Developed math website: appmsaga.colorado.edu
Developed math trivia and platform games
Developed front-end interfaces for system databases
Instructor for Digital CUrrents summer program teaching Adobe ActionScript

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed a proof of concept in data and video synchronization
Worked on a team for major software product
Tested and fixed problems before a release

positions.title: System Administrator Assistant
positions.description:
Installing and updating software
Network setup and maintenance
Developed a medical patient check-in program in Visual Basic
